title: Loomis’s figure drawing book is available again.
content: One of the classic books on figure drawing by a master illustrator from the mid-20th century is available again.Figure Drawing for All It's Worthwas one of my favorites when I was starting out, and I copied many plates from it. For a long time it was out of print and very expensive. The new edition from Titan books is very well produced with good paper and accurate tonality.Figure Drawing for All It's Worthby Andrew LoomisThanks,Charley!
